summary: #edu407 Assessing comprehension is tricky and as students get older we then mix in reading and writing as primary way we ask students to demonstrate comprehension is through written responses. So are you measuring what they understand about a text or a student's ability to construct a response?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: #edu407 Assessing comprehension is tricky and as students get older we then mix in reading and writing as primary way we ask students to demonstrate comprehension is through written responses. So are you measuring what they understand about a text or a student's ability to construct a response?
